concepts.gloss_en: Yom Kippur, the Day of Atonement

reason_for_human: All three occurrences refer to the same holiday, the Day of Atonement. The two surface forms (יום כפור / יום הכפורים) differ only by the definite article and plene spelling — plain inflectional/orthographic variation of one word, not homographs. The paragraph contexts confirm identical meaning (fasting, sealing, the day after Yom Kippur).
